newsitem.title: UK: Saatchi & Saatchi announces Laing as chief exec.
newsitem.headline: Saatchi & Saatchi announces Laing as chief exec.

text.p: Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising, which is part of Cordiant Plc, announced on Thursday the appointment of Jennifer Laing, the head of its London office, as new chief executive officer of the agency for North America.
Saatchi said in a statement Laing, who will take up the appointment in New York on January 1, would replace Alan Bishop, current chief executive of Saatchi & Saatchi North America.
The agency said Bishop would relocate to London effective January 1 and assume Laing's present job as chairman of Saatchi & Saatchi, London.

"Saatchi & Saatchi is a powerful global network. These appointments are integral to our mission to better serve our clients around the world..." Cordiant's chief executive, Bob Seelert, said about the appointments.

"We are fortunate to be able to deploy industry talent of this stature around our network, leveraging off their skills and experience as we build on Saatchi & Saatchi's client service worldwide," he said.

Ed Wax, chairman and chief executive officer of Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising Worldwide, said in New York the agency's performance in North America had been revitalised under Bishop and that he had spear-headed some big new business wins.
"His experience of successfully running our operations in the world's most important advertising market will bring much to our operation in London," he said.
"I admire Jennifer's achievements tremendously. This is the perfect time for her to breathe more of that special Saatchi culture into our North American operations," Wax said.
Industry sources say Saatchi & Saatchi has been keen to revitalise its North American operations since the departure nearly two years ago of its founders, Maurice and Charles Saatchi.
The Saatchi brothers, who were forced out following a shareholder revolt, set up a rival agency last year, M&C Saatchi.

Laing worked for Saatchi & Saatchi for 17 years before setting up her own agency, Laing Henry. Laing Henry was then bought by Cordiant in early 1995, when Jennifer Laing rejoined Saatchi & Saatchi as chairman of its London office.
Following her appointment, Saatchi & Saatchi has won several industry awards, including being nominated "Agency of the Year" at the Cannes advertising festival this year.
